name: Fast volume rotation using binary shear-warp factorization
aliases: 3D volume rotation decomposition into shear transformations
Fast Volume Rotation via Shear-Warp and Super Cells
definition: A fast volume rotation technique that skips precisely empty regions along rays to be evaluated without trading image quality for speed or requiring specialized hardware.
summary: Fast volume rotation using binary shear-warp factorization accelerates interactive volume rendering by using super cells and bitwise operations to precisely skip transparent regions without specialized hardware.
